JasmineCianwoodPharmacyText:
JASMINE: … This
#MON always

kept the sea lit
at night.

…But it suddenly
got sick… It's gasping for air…

…I understand
that there is a

wonderful PHARMACY
in CIANWOOD…

But that's across
the sea…

And I can't leave
AMPHY unattended…
JasmineGetSomeMedicineText:
…May I ask you to
get some medicine for me? Please?
JasmineDontBeOffendedText:
JASMINE: …Um,
please don't be offended…

…AMPHY will not
take anything from anyone but me…
JasmineAmphyHowAreYouFeelingText:
JASMINE: …

AMPHY, how are you
feeling?
JasmineThankYouText:
JASMINE: …Oh, I'm
so relieved…

This is just so
wonderful…

Thank you so very,
very much.

…I will return to
the GYM…
